name: Venture firm
blurb: A venture firm's deals, portfolio, people and investment theses, with every signal tied to the beliefs it supports or contradicts.
about: A living system of record for a venture firm: its companies, people and deals, what was said and written about them, and the insights, patterns and theses the firm builds from those. A new company arrives against what the firm already believes, and every decision keeps the beliefs it rested on. Agents source, brief, chase commitments and draft conclusions on their own branches, and the deal or thesis owner reviews before a merge.
sample: Quito Capital, a fictional AI-infrastructure fund
